query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create and publish a HubSpot quote for a CRM contact by first finding the contact, creating a deal, creating line items and a quote, applying quote terms and template settings, publishing the quote, and inspecting quote/template properties.
query_ground_truth.query: create HubSpot line items and quote
query_ground_truth.intent: Create line items and generate a new quote associated with the deal.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=hubspot. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="hubspot") to create a connection BEFORE executing any hubspot tools.

HUBSPOT_CREATE_QUOTE_OBJECT.description: Creates a new quote object in HubSpot CRM with specified properties and associations.

properties.description: A dictionary of key-value pairs representing the properties of the quote to be created. Property names are HubSpot internal names.

to.description: Object containing the ID of the existing object to associate the new quote with.

associationTypeId.description: The ID that specifies the type of association. For example, to associate a quote with a deal, use the appropriate HubSpot-defined ID.

associationCategory.description: The category of the association. HubSpot-defined associations are created by HubSpot, user-defined are created by users, and integrator-defined are created by integrations.

items.description: Request schema for defining an association type between objects.

types.description: A list of association types to create between the new quote and other objects.

items.description: Request schema for specifying associations to be created with the quote.

associations.description: A list of associations to create for the new quote. Each item specifies the object to associate with and the type of association.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_LINE_ITEMS.description: Fetches a paginated list of HubSpot CRM line items, allowing selection of specific properties (including history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status; ensure property and association names are valid HubSpot internal names.

after.description: Pagination token from 'paging.next.after' of a previous response to fetch the subsequent page. Omit for the first request.

limit.description: Maximum number of line items to return per page; controls response size. An API-defined upper limit may apply.

archived.description: Filter by archive status: `true` for archived only, `false` (default) for active only. Manages historical or current items.

properties.description: Property names to include for each line item (e.g., `["name", "price"]`); customizes returned data. Non-existent properties are ignored. If omitted, a default set is returned.

associations.description: Object types (e.g., `["deal", "product"]`) for which to retrieve associated IDs. Invalid types are ignored. Valid types depend on HubSpot data model.

propertiesWithHistory.description: Property names for which to include historical values (e.g., `["status", "amount"]`); tracks changes. May reduce items returned per request due to increased payload.

HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES.description: Lists all valid association types between two specified HubSpot CRM object types.

toObjectType.description: The type of the second object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).

fromObjectType.description: The type of the first object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_LINE_ITEM_BY_ID.description: Retrieves a HubSpot CRM line item by its ID or a specified unique property (`idProperty`).
